_comment: Services voice can allow by name (#13). Patterns use the POST /rules syntax: a.com is that host only, *.a.com is a.com and every subdomain. No pattern may cover a domain on the shipped blocklists (tests/test_voice_allow.py), so Netflix and YouTube list their hosts instead of *.netflix.com and *.youtube.com, and Prime Video leaves out aiv-delivery.net and pv-cdn.net. Best-effort from public knowledge of each app, not checked against captured traffic.
